decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
That details for noise and acoustic insulation values pursuant to condition 7 of approval, ref 1239/H/P36 for the conversion of the Listed Building to provide 8 residential units, demolition of greenhouse and works to boundary wall, together with the erection of 5 two storey dwellings at the rear dated 19 November 2007, received 13 October 2006 be approved as the proposals would protect the new housing from noise.
description: Following approval for conversion of listed building to provide 8 residential units, demolition of greenhouse and works to boundary wall, together with  the erection of 5 two storey dwellings at the rear with associated landscaping and car parking- details submitted pursuant to  Condition 7 (Noise and acoustic insulation values) of approved appeal dated 13/06/07
